project: Lenovo TB8504 Android 16 / LineageOS 23.2 staged bring-up

release_identity.reason: Android 16 lunch requires product/release/variant. bp1a configured the wrong platform state and previously triggered SDK/config incompatibility.

partition_contract.vendor_topology_observation: Baseline BoardConfigVendor.mk is empty and fstab.qcom has no /vendor mount. Detect actual build topology before attempting vendorimage; vendor may live under /system/vendor.

cloud_seed.integrity: 97 ZIP entries; testzip clean; 96/96 SHA256SUMS verified; no credential-pattern findings
cloud_seed.coverage_blocker: hardware/qcom-caf/msm8996/gps was listed in EXPORTED_REPOS but absent from REPOS metadata and per-repo patch/status/mbox; exporter/auditor are now hardened and the next seed must capture it.
cloud_seed.legacy_seed_reason: Historical seed predates complete GPS/workspace provenance and v2 requested/missing-repo metadata. Generate a new v2 seed from the current autopilot converge goal.

accepted_local_dirty_state: scripts/sign-file legacy Perl compatibility parser modification
kernel_and_module_history.critical_decision: Never replace the local boot kernel/modules with cloud-built kernel/modules and never weaken signing coherence. Canonical final build is local so kernel and modules are built/signed together.

runtime_cleanup_history.old_stage8l12_observation: Backups showed a broader historical removal set (~70 services), so absence must never be inferred solely from the old no-install-rule audit.

camera.runtime_model: legacy standalone camera daemon removed; camera HAL runs in-process

wfd.reason: Java/app remnants were left after backend removal and were not visible to ELF-only audits.

ims.reason: The old cleanup removed init definitions even though proprietary executables and runtime/VINTF contracts were still present.

runtime_cleanup_history.shell_syntax_gate: All transformed rootdir shell scripts must pass bash -n.

known_build_failures_and_fixes.fix: Disable nounset before sourcing build/envsetup.sh; retain -e and pipefail outside envsetup.

known_build_failures_and_fixes.cause: Android 16 lunch format requires product, release, variant

known_build_failures_and_fixes.symptom: bp1a selected and SDK/platform configuration mismatch
known_build_failures_and_fixes.fix: Pin trunk_staging and verify PLATFORM_SDK_VERSION=36, PLATFORM_VERSION=16*, LINEAGE_VERSION=23.2-*.

known_build_failures_and_fixes.symptom: Key "PRIVATE_BUILD_DESC" isn't a valid prop override
known_build_failures_and_fixes.cause: Legacy PRODUCT_BUILD_PROP_OVERRIDES key rejected by Android 16 gen_build_prop

known_build_failures_and_fixes.fix: Migrate TARGET_DEVICE to DeviceName while preserving stock BUILD_FINGERPRINT.

known_build_failures_and_fixes.symptom: Residual cleanup fails on WfdService/WfdCommon found 0 on a second run
known_build_failures_and_fixes.cause: Old helper was not idempotent and local runner was pinned to an obsolete tooling ref
known_build_failures_and_fixes.fix: Use current idempotent helper set and prove second-run ALREADY_APPLIED/CHANGED_FILES=0.

known_build_failures_and_fixes.cause: Escaped shell expansion leaked into generated runner
known_build_failures_and_fixes.fix: Reject runner/tool files containing unintended escaped shell expansions; lint with bash -n.
Do not fail solely on those warnings. Require expected 12 .ko set, modules.dep, coherent module signatures, and image/kernel match.

known_build_failures_and_fixes.cause: Cloud kernel/modules were signed with a different certificate than the local canonical build
known_build_failures_and_fixes.fix: Do not weaken signing gate. Build canonical kernel/modules/images together locally.

known_build_failures_and_fixes.symptom: Full mka bacon takes hours and exposes errors late
known_build_failures_and_fixes.cause: Using full ROM build as an intermediate diagnostic
known_build_failures_and_fixes.fix: Build staged targets and audit each layer first; run bacon only after staged gates pass.

known_build_failures_and_fixes.symptom: Stale module-info.json can survive source transforms
known_build_failures_and_fixes.cause: module-info.json is cached build metadata and may describe the previous source state
known_build_failures_and_fixes.fix: Converge uses source-only runtime evidence. Build goals run AOSP refreshmod and then repeat the runtime audit with fresh module-info.json.

known_build_failures_and_fixes.symptom: Android 16 tree advertises background blur on low-end TB8504
known_build_failures_and_fixes.cause: Newer device-tree properties enabled SurfaceFlinger blur capability while carrying mixed-generation graphics tuning
known_build_failures_and_fixes.fix: Set ro.surface_flinger.supports_background_blur=0, remove stale debug.sf.disable_backpressure, retain proven Android-10-era Qualcomm graphics settings until hardware frame-timing evidence says otherwise.

known_build_failures_and_fixes.symptom: mka returns success while a stale target image remains unchanged
known_build_failures_and_fixes.cause: Ninja can report the requested target up to date even when the autopilot source fingerprint changed or a dependency edge was missed
known_build_failures_and_fixes.fix: Capture pre-build SHA256/size/mtime and refuse source re-binding when a stale boot/recovery/system/vendor artifact was not actually refreshed.

known_build_failures_and_fixes.symptom: checkvintf passes while kernel requirements are silently skipped
known_build_failures_and_fixes.cause: checkvintf omits runtime kernel requirements unless --kernel receives the built kernel release and config
known_build_failures_and_fixes.fix: Require ro.product.first_api_level=25 and run checkvintf with the built KERNEL_OBJ release plus .config.

boot_earlier.note: Boot passed structural/kernel audit before later IMS/WFD/product-compat source changes. A fresh boot rebuild is required before treating boot as final.

workflow_history.important_rule: Source-side PASS is not final authority for produced images. Built artifacts in out/ must be audited after each build.

autopilot_policy.final_authority: Actual built output plus post-build audits; never source audit alone.
converge_side_effects: automatic audited cloud seed v2 export
optional --upload-seed handoff through the same tb8504-autopilot.py entry point
when upload is selected, the STAGE8N request commit is parented directly to TOOLING_REF and the branch update must be fast-forward
after every STAGE8N gate passes, GitHub promotes the captured GPS/device/vendor/workspace provenance into autopilot-knowledge.json with a fast-forward-only commit

promotion_requires: seed SHA256 and ZIP integrity PASS
seed TOOLING_REF equals the request commit parent
workspace fingerprint recomputes from the full project inventory
GPS and device/vendor provenance is structurally valid and bound to exported patch data
branch HEAD still equals the STAGE8N request commit

provenance_hardening: converge captures workspace, GPS, device/vendor and static build-critical repository provenance before seed handoff
seed audit binds device/vendor/GPS untracked files by path, byte SHA256, size and Unix mode; untracked symlinks are rejected
STAGE8N reconstructs device and vendor from approved baseline HEAD + tracked patch + untracked files and verifies exact git status
device tar must match the provenance-reconstructed device tree including file type, mode, size and content
static build-critical repository provenance is bound to exported patch bytes and rechecked against approved knowledge contracts before promotion
provenance promotion is allowed only after all STAGE8N gates pass and while the branch still points at the immutable request commit
GPS provenance is git-backed only; non-git GPS trees are rejected before export because the canonical seed requires per-repo HEAD/patch/status metadata

source_integrity_contracts.policy: converge may collect an unproven GPS or dynamic-primary state; every build goal must stop until GPS and post-convergence device/vendor integrity contracts are explicit

workspace_repo_contract.policy: all repo projects contribute path+HEAD; dirty projects outside the explicitly modeled target/host set are forbidden

seed_provenance_policy.untracked_contract: path+type+unix_mode+size+sha256; exact archive coverage; symlinks rejected
seed_provenance_policy.device_reconstruction: baseline HEAD + tracked patch + untracked, then exact status and tar metadata/content equivalence
seed_provenance_policy.vendor_reconstruction: baseline HEAD + tracked patch + untracked, then exact status
seed_provenance_policy.static_repos: captured at local contract gate and re-bound to seed patch bytes before STAGE8N acceptance

source_integrity_contracts.gps_provenance_policy: canonical v2 provenance requires hardware/qcom-caf/msm8996/gps to be a readable git worktree; plain-tree mode is rejected before seed export

memory_model.decision: Do not force modern PSI/memcg lmkd without a deliberate kernel backport.

performance_contract.rationale: Keep the Android-10-era Qualcomm CPU/ZRAM/LMK tuning that was already known-good, while disabling Android 16 blur capability and removing only a SurfaceFlinger property no longer consumed by Android 16.

local_boot_recovery: expected TB8504 DTB present and embedded
final_system: actual installed ELF DT_NEEDED graph and bitness
all installed vendor ELF consumers are re-audited against bitness-correct providers, not only PRODUCT_COPY_FILES entries
host checkvintf receives ro.product.first_api_level=25 and the built kernel release + .config so kernel VINTF requirements are not skipped
final_ota: system.new.dat(.br/.xz) new/zero blocks bound to staged system.img
payload.bin and super.img are forbidden because TB8504 is legacy static non-A/B
audit_hardening_current.build_metadata: Source-only converge never trusts stale module-info.json. Every build goal runs AOSP refreshmod and re-audits runtime contracts before compiling images.
artifact_binding: boot/recovery/system/vendor/ROM state is bound to SOURCE_FINGERPRINT plus SHA256
a successful mka target may not re-bind a stale artifact unless the produced file is demonstrably refreshed
bacon applies the same stale-output refresh requirement to boot/recovery/system when their bindings are stale
provenance: untracked provenance includes Unix mode and exact byte coverage
device and vendor are reconstructed from provenance rather than trusted as opaque exported state
static source provenance closes audit-to-export TOCTOU
